chapters.title: Once there was an old man…
p: Once there was an old man who wanted to have some fun. So he went to the park and brought his old kite. He started to pull it and the kite flew very high. Suddenly, a jolly ghost appeared.
The old man was scared but the ghost said, "Don't be afraid. If you give me a hug, I will help you fly your kite."
The old man thought for a moment and then he said, "Yes! I will give you a hug." With the ghost's help, the man's kite flew even higher.
The old man laughed and said, "Thank you, jolly ghost."
The ghost replied, "My pleasure! Anytime you want to fly your kite, just pull me for help!"
And ever since then, every time the old man pulled his kite, the jolly ghost was always there to help him fly it high.

chapters.title: Timmy was restless as he searched…
p: Timmy was restless as he searched the house high and low. He looked under his bed and behind the couch, but he couldn't find his favorite poem. He asked his mom if she had seen it.
"No, I haven't sweetheart," Mom replied. "But I'm sure if you keep looking you'll find it."
Timmy kept searching but still couldn't find the poem. He started to get very sad when all of a sudden he remembered where it was - under a pile of toys in his room!
He ran to his room and sure enough, there it was! Timmy was so excited and hugged his beloved poem tight. He had found it!
From that day on, Timmy never forgot where he kept his poem. He was so happy and he knew he'd never lose it again.

chapters.title: Once there was a popular furniture…
p: Once there was a popular furniture store. All of the furniture was in perfect condition. Everyone loved buying furniture at the store.
One day a wicked witch came to the store. She was so angry that she wanted to destroy the furniture. She shouted, "Destroy, destroy!", as she waved her wand.
The furniture began to shake and wobble. Everything eventually broke and pieces were all over the floor. The witch laughed in delight and flew away.
The store owner came into the store and was so sad to see the furniture destroyed. She shouted, "Oh no! Who did this to my store!"
Just then a small voice spoke up. A little girl of three years old had been hiding in the corner. She said, "It was a witch! A wicked witch who wanted to destroy all the furniture!"
The store owner was amazed. She thanked the little girl for warning her. With a smile, she said, "Good job! I will make sure to keep my store safer next time."

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a bouncy kitten called Lucy who lived with her mom and dad in a cozy house. Every day, Lucy would go out and wander in the sunshine, looking for fun.
One day, when she was out exploring, she spotted something glinting in the grass. She went over to take a look and saw that it was a hoop! It was made of shiny metal and it made Lucy feel so excited.
She picked up the hoop and started to play with it, rolling it around and hopping over it too. She wiggled and jiggled and had the best time ever.
Nearby, her mom was watching and called out, "Lucy, come here! What's that you have there?"
Lucy proudly held up the hoop and announced, "Look! I found this hoop and it's so playful!"
Her mom smiled and said, "Yes it is. You can keep it and play with it whenever you want."
After that, Lucy was always seen wandering with her hoop, playing and having lots of fun. The end.

chapters.title: Once there was a little girl…
p: Once there was a little girl named Sally. Sally was three years old and she loved to explore new places.
One day Sally's mommy took her to a new room in the house. It was a special room with a big white toilet in it.
Sally's mommy said, “Sally, this is the toilet. You can sit on it when you have to go pee or poop.” Sally looked at the toilet and then said, “It looks dry!”
Sally's mommy smiled and said, “Yes, it's dry now. But when you sit on it and go pee or poop it's not dry anymore.”
Sally was excited to learn about the toilet and she said, “Can I sit on the toilet now?”
Sally's mommy said, “Sure! Let's go back to the bathroom and you can give it a try!”
So Sally went back to the bathroom, carefully stepped on the toilet seat, and sat down. She smiled as she felt the dryness of the toilet seat. “I like this toilet!” she said happily.
From then on, Sally used the toilet whenever she had to go pee or poop.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Steve who loved to explore. He was always curious about the world around him.
One day, he decided to take a walk in the woods. As he was walking, he came across an amazing old shipwreck. He couldn't believe his eyes!
In the shipwreck, he discovered a gold chest. He stared at it in wonder and didn't know what to do. A voice suddenly said "Hey little boy, you shouldn't mind the chest! It might be dangerous."
Steve looked around, but couldn't see anyone. Then, he looked up and saw a fairy flying above him.
The fairy said "I'm looking after the chest, so don't mind it! Just enjoy yourself and explore the wreck, you'll find it amazing."
So Steve spent the rest of the afternoon exploring the shipwreck and finding all kinds of things inside. He had an amazing adventure, and never forgot the magic he experienced that day.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a girl called Daisy. Daisy was playing outside with her friends. She found a glove on the ground and decided to pick it up. She passed the glove to her friend, saying, "This glove is for you!"
Her friend smiled and said, "Thanks, Daisy, this is a nice glove!"
Daisy was so happy that she started jumping and spinning around. Suddenly she got so dizzy that she fell down. Her friends quickly came to her side and asked if she was okay.
"I'm fine," said Daisy. "I'm just a bit dizzy from spinning so much!"
Her friends laughed and shared a big hug. They continued playing, until it was time for Daisy to go home.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was walking in the park with her daddy. She saw a man with a mustache. He was wearing a hat and a big smile. "Look, Daddy, a man with a mustache," she said.
Daddy smiled. "Yes," he said. "What a delicate mustache it is!"

The girl and her daddy watched the man as he walked on. He was humming a happy song and the sun was shining brightly down on him. The girl felt so happy. She started to run and twirl in the sun, letting it shine off her dress.
Suddenly the man stopped walking, turned around and smiled at the girl and her dad. He pointed to his mustache and said, "This mustache shines so bright, just like you!"
The girl blushed and smiled. She looked at her daddy who nodded and said, "It sure does."
The man smiled, tipped his hat and walked away, as the sun shone down brightly on all of them.

chapters.title: Johnny was at the beach with…
p: Johnny was at the beach with his parents. He saw some dolphins swimming in the ocean. He wanted to touch them, but his dad told him not to.
Johnny said, "I miss dolphins."
His mom replied, "That's ok, Johnny. We can come back again soon."
Suddenly, a filthy dolphin came up to Johnny. It was sick and it had some strange bumps on it.
Johnny smiled and said, "Hi, dolphin."
The dolphin looked up at Johnny. Then it slowly swam away.
Johnny watched it go. He said, "Bye, dolphin. I miss you."
His parents smiled at each other and hugged Johnny. Then they all went home.

chapters.title: Little Jimmy was so happy He…
p: Little Jimmy was so happy! He had won a shiny golden chain at the fair. He was so excited that he ran and showed his mama right away.
"Mama, I won a chain!" he cried.
"Jimmy, that's wonderful!" his mama said, as she hugged him tight.
Jimmy always wanted to win something, and today he did. Mama said that he had to be careful and keep the chain safe.
Just then, they heard a nasty growl coming from the doorway. It was Big Dog.
Big Dog was very ignorant; he didn't even understand the concept of winning. He tried to pounce at Jimmy, but Jimmy was so fast! He ran away holding the chain tightly.
Big Dog growled again, and ran after Jimmy.
But Jimmy was so good at running and was much faster than Big Dog. Jimmy was getting away!
Then he quickly hopped over a fence, and Big Dog could not get him. In the end, Jimmy kept his chain.
Jimmy was so proud of himself. He had won something and he kept it safe from Big Dog. What a great day!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Bella. She was very stubborn, and always wanted things in her own way.
One day, Bella saw a big, colorful balloon in the sky. She wanted the balloon, so she started crying and stamping her feet.
Bella's mom came to her and said, "oh Bella, don't be so stubborn. You can't get the balloon, so please try to calm down."
But Bella kept on crying and shouting, "I want the balloon! I want the balloon!"
So her mom said, "If you'll stop crying and settle down, I'll get you a balloon from the store. Will that make you happy?"
Bella stopped crying and smiled. She said, "Yes please, that would make me feel so much better."
So Bella's mom bought her a lovely, shiny new balloon. Bella was so excited to have her balloon, and hugged it tight. She never was so stubborn again!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little girl named Molly. She wanted to go to the beach, so she started to run. When she arrived she was so excited. She saw the bright blue ocean and felt the sand beneath her toes.
Molly ran over to the edge of the water. She held out her hand and waved it in the water. Suddenly, a little fish swam up to her palm. "Yummy!" said Molly as she laughed.
Molly couldn't believe her luck. She made a wish and threw the fish back into the sea. "Please come back!" shouted Molly.
Just then, a voice said: "What did you wish for?"
Molly was very excited. She looked around to see where the voice had come from. Then she spotted a bright pink mermaid in the water. "I wished for a special surprise," said Molly.
The mermaid smiled. She said: "Let's start playing hide and seek!"

Molly had lots of fun playing hide and seek with her new friend in the sea. When it was time for Molly to go, she hugged the mermaid goodbye and skipped all the way home with a big smile on her face, knowing she had made a special new friend.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a young boy who wanted to buy something magical. He went to the store, but nothing seemed special. He asked the storekeeper, "What is the most beautiful thing you have?" The storekeeper said, "A rainbow. It is so clear and bright."
The boy was so excited. He took out his piggy bank. He counted his coins and he had enough to buy the rainbow. He gave the coins to the storekeeper and he said, "Thank you".
The boy ran home with his rainbow. As soon as he opened it, a magical voice said, "Your wish is my command". The boy wanted to be able to fly. The magical rainbow made it happen.
The boy was so happy and excited. He flew over the town, feeling the wind in his hair. He was like a bird and he was so free. He thanked the magical rainbow for his wish come true.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Jack who had a teddy bear. Every day, when he was scared or sad, Jack hugged the teddy bear and it made him feel better.

One day, Jack noticed that the teddy bear was looking very worn and tattered. His mom saw how much he liked the teddy bear, so she went to the store to get a new one. She found a round, cheap teddy bear that looked like an exact replacement.
When they got home and Jack saw the teddy bear, he was so happy! He hugged it and said, “Thank you, mommy!”
His mommy smiled and said, “You’re welcome, Jack. It’s there to comfort you whenever you’re scared or sad.”
Jack smiled back and said, “I love you, mommy.” Then he hugged the teddy bear tightly and was comforted.

chapters.title: Mommy looked over at her three…
p: Mommy looked over at her three year old daughter and said with a smile, "Do you want to go on an adventure today?"
The little girl excitedly nodded her head in agreement. Mommy grabbed her hand, and urged her to hurry up.
The two of them walked quickly down the street, not sure what kind of adventure they were heading off to.
When they arrived, the little girl was confused. There were lots of crazy colors everywhere, and she couldn't make sense of it.
She asked Mommy why they were there, and Mommy smiled and said, "We're here to make something special." She took a roll of tape and said, "Let me show you!"
Mommy started spinning the tape around, until she had made a giant circle. She was making a twirly-whirly, dizzy top.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Molly. She was very excited to explore the world, so she wandered everywhere she could.
One day, Molly saw something magical, it was a sparkly rainbow that was in the sky. She wanted to get closer to it, so she walked towards it, but she was a bit scared.
A friendly voice said, "It's ok Molly, you can be safe, just follow me!" She looked up to see a beautiful fairy. Molly felt safe, so they wandered together until they reached the rainbow.

The fairy waved her wand and said, "I'm sorry you can't touch the rainbow Molly, but here, I've brought something special for you!" With a few more waves of her wand, a tiny sparkly butterfly appeared right in front of them.
Molly was delighted! She thanked the fairy kindly as she held the butterfly in her hands. Molly then said goodbye to the fairy and wandered off, with her new magical friend.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a girl named Elizabeth who was three years old. She was walking in the park one day when she noticed something exciting. She saw a big machine and went to take a look closer. She saw that it was a massage machine. She was eager to try it out and lay down on the bed.
Suddenly, the machine started to move and the bed started to shake.
"Wow!" Elizabeth said with a big smile.
The machine then started to give her a massage. It felt so good. Elizabeth was so happy and couldn't wait for her massage to finish.
When it was done, she thanked the machine then went to find her mommy.
"Mommy! I had a massage!" Elizabeth said excitedly as she hugged her mom.
Her mommy smiled and said, "That's great, darling! I'm glad you enjoyed it."
Elizabeth smiled back, eager for next time.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She had a wonderful mom and dad. One day, Lucy wanted to draw a picture. She asked her mom for a special piece of paper. Her mom said, "Sure, here you go." She handed Lucy a white sheet.
Lucy was so excited. She wanted to get to work right away. She quickly grabbed a yellow crayon and began to draw.
Suddenly, she heard a noise. It was her mom. Mom said, "Oh no!" Apparently, Lucy had drawn on the wrong sheet. It was an important piece of paper with numbers on it.
Lucy felt bad. She said in a small voice, "Sorry."
Mom smiled and said, "It's ok sweetheart. I accept your apology."
Mom gave Lucy a hug and they went back to drawing together. Lucy used a different sheet and created the most beautiful picture. They were both very happy.
The end.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a brave bear cub. He was on an adventure through the deep, dark forest. After walking for a long time, he was getting very tired and hungry.
Suddenly, he heard something rustling in the bushes close by. He froze and listened carefully. It was the sound of something coming towards him!
He held his breath as a big monster stepped out of the bushes. It was big and hairy and had thick, sharp claws. The bear cub was so scared he started to shake.
“Don’t be afraid little one,” said the monster in a low voice. “I won’t hurt you. I have a spear for you to use.”
The bear cub was shocked. But, he trusted the monster and took the spear from him.
The monster smiled. “Good luck on your journey little one!” he said.
The bear cub thanked the monster and held the thick spear tightly in his paws. He was now brave and ready to finish his adventure!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a furry duck named Daisy. Daisy was very lonely, until one day she saw a little girl and went up to her.
"Hello! What's your name?" asked Daisy.
"My name is Amelia," said the little girl.
"Would you like to play with me?"
"Yes, I would!" said Amelia.
They started to sort through Daisy's toys. Daisy had lots of colorful toys, so they sorted them by color. When they were done, the room was much neater.
Daisy was so happy she had a new friend that she started dancing around in circles.
"Let's go for a walk!" said Daisy.
So Daisy and Amelia went outside and walked around the pond, where Daisy spotted her friends - a group of other furry ducks.
Amelia was so excited to meet them, and Daisy was so happy to have a new friend. They played all day until it was time to go home.
From that day on, Daisy and Amelia were best friends. They played together every day and Daisy's loneliness was gone.

chapters.title: Once upon a time in a…
p: Once upon a time in a small town, there lived two beetles, Bill and Bob. Bill was an intelligent beetle and Bob was not so smart.
One day when Bill and Bob were playing hide and seek in the garden, Bob found an interesting hole in the ground. He shouted, "Bill! I found a hole. Can I bury myself in it?"
Bill saw the hole and told Bob: "No, Bob! That hole is too deep and it might be dangerous. Let's find something else to bury".
Bob thought for a while and then said, "What about this little rock? We can bury it here in the garden and make it a surprise for when we play again tomorrow".

So, with their tiny beetle hands, Bill and Bob worked together to bury their little rock in the ground. As Bill and Bob patted down the last of the dirt on their buried rock, Bill said, "It's a perfect spot for our little surprise".
Then Bill went to the edge of the garden and said, "Let's fly up to the tree and have a look around".
Bob looked at Bill with big eyes and said, "Wow, you're so intelligent, Bill".
Bill smiled and replied, "Let's go and explore what this garden has to offer us!"

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a nice little girl. She was having a fun day. She decided to go for a walk. As she walked down the street, she saw something amazing. It was a welcome sign. She had never seen a sign like this before.
The girl ran to it and read it out loud: "Welcome to our town!" She thought it was very nice and decided to say hello. She waved and said, "Hello! What is this place?"
Just then, a friendly lady walked out of the house. She said, "Welcome! This is a wonderful town. We have lots of amazing things to see. Would you like a tour?"
The girl was so excited. She said, "Yes please!" The lady smiled and said, "Come with me!"
The girl followed the lady and had the most amazing time. She saw so many beautiful things and experienced so much.
At the end of the tour, the lady said, "Welcome to our town! I hope you come back soon!"
The little girl smiled and said, "Thank you! This was an amazing adventure!"

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was an ostrich who liked to run. She ran everywhere. But then, she noticed something different. She saw a creature that looked a bit like her, standing still.
The ostrich said, "Hello! What are you doing?"
The creature replied, "I'm an elephant, and I'm just standing here."
The ostrich said, "That looks fun! Can I try it?"
The elephant said, "Sure! Just stand still and try not to move."
The ostrich tried it. She stood still and stopped running. She liked it! It felt different, but also fun.
Then, the elephant said, "Let's go explore this place together."
The ostrich was very happy. She said, "Yes, let's go!"
So, the elephant and the ostrich walked together, and explored the world around them. They both liked it, and had lots of fun.

chapters.title: Once there was a little girl…
p: Once there was a little girl called Hannah. She was 3 years old and had just moved to a new town. One day, her mummy and daddy took her to a huge place called a stadium. It was so big, she felt scared.
Mummy and Daddy said, "Come on Hannah, let's go inside and take a look!" But Hannah was scared. She loved her mummy and daddy and didn't want to go if they weren't with her.
Mummy said, "It's OK, Hannah. We'll be here with you. We love you and we won't leave you alone."
Hannah felt better. She smiled and took her mummy and daddy's hands and they went inside the stadium together. Inside they saw a football pitch, lots of seats and loud noises.
Hannah had so much fun with her mummy and daddy. She laughed, smiled and felt brave again.
Hannah said, "I love you, Mummy and Daddy!"
Mummy and Daddy smiled and said, "We love you too, darling!"

chapters.title: Once upon a time there were…
p: Once upon a time, there were two friends named Bob and Lucy. They liked to play together every day.
One day, Bob and Lucy decided to sit down and have a chat. They both sat in comfy chairs next to each other.
Lucy said to Bob, "Let's have a tea party!" Bob smiled and said, "Okay!" Then he handed Lucy a kind mug.
Lucy said thank you to Bob and then she made tea in the mug. After they finished the tea, they sat outside and watched the birds chirping in the trees.
Bob said, "That was the nicest tea party ever!" And Lucy smiled and said, "Yes, it was!"
